task: The safety_inspections folder holds a year of inspections — `2024_01_january_warehouse_safety_inspection_report.pdf` in January, fire protection in February, hazardous goods in May, occupational health in June, labour protection in October, chemical storage in November and a year-end summary in December, several with a paired rectification tracker. Work out which hazards were found, which were closed by a tracker and which were not, and whether any hazard recurs in a later inspection after being marked closed. Produce a year-end review that says something the December summary does not already say.
